description: This Java source file defines the interface 'CommandStrategy' which specifies a strategy pattern for handling commands within a persistent actor context. The interface includes methods for matching command classes, applying strategies, and checking if strategies are defined for given commands and contexts. It also contains a nested interface 'Context' representing execution context, including state and logging facilities.

classes.name: CommandStrategy
classes.description: A generic interface for command handling strategies, parameterized by command, entity, context, and result types.

classes.name: CommandStrategy.Context
classes.description: An inner interface defining the execution context with methods to access state and logging.

methods.name: getMatchingClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the type of command this strategy handles.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the strategy with the provided context, entity, revision, and command, returning a result.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if the strategy is applicable to the given command.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Default method to check if the strategy is applicable to a command within a specific context and entity.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state from the context.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Provides access to the log adapter in the context.
